story.text: At a dinner at Hartfield, Mr. Woodhouse is {SORRY} to hear that Jane walked to the {POST} office in the rain, in thin {SHOES}. Why does she {INSIST} on fetching her own {LETTERS} every day? Jane only colours. Mrs. Elton cannot stop {MEDDLING}: she will send her own servant.
story.caption: “I am very sorry to hear, Miss Fairfax, of your being out this morning in the rain.”
